Summary:

Through this refactoring, the project evolved from a single-use notebook into a maintainable machine learning codebase.



| Dimension | Before Refactoring | After Refactoring | 

| --------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------- | 

| Structure | Flat Jupyter cells | Modular Python modules | 

| Reproducibility | Manual seeds | Centralized config | 

| Logging | `print()` | Structured logger | 

| Experimentation | Manual | Configurable sweeps | 

| Maintainability | Low | High |



This structure now supports both educational transparency and engineering rigor, serving as a clean baseline for future deep learning experiments.
